# Comfy Colab Kit

> Wake-on-demand ComfyUI on Google Colab. A lightweight aiohttp gateway (comfy-gate) that runs either 100% locally on your Mac/PC (zero VPS, zero domain, zero Cloudflare setup) or on a cloud Linux VPS behind Cloudflare Access. Shows a Hugging-Face-Space-style wake page, starts one shared Colab L4 session via the colab CLI, streams progress to every viewer over SSE, reverse-proxies ComfyUI (incl. /ws), and auto-stops on idle, max session, quiet hours or compute-unit budget. Built-in profiles for MOSS-Image, FLUX.2 Klein 4B, Wan 2.2 & LTX-Video (T2V/I2V), SD 3.5, and Qwen-Image.

## For Autonomous AI Agents (Local Execution)
1. **Bootstrap**: Run `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.local.yml up -d` or `python3 -m gate` (requires `AUTH_DISABLED=true` in `.env`).
2. **Inspect**: Call `GET http://localhost:8080/_gate/healthz` and `GET http://localhost:8080/_gate/profiles`.
3. **Connect via MCP**: Spawn `ckit mcp --gate-url http://localhost:8080` via stdio. Zero tokens or Cloudflare headers required.
4. **Generate**: Call `gate_wake` with a profile (e.g. `flux-klein` or `wan-ltx-video`), queue prompts with `gate_txt2img` / `gate_img2img`, and call `gate_stop` upon completion.

## API
- [apps/gate/openapi.yaml](apps/gate/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 for /_gate/*
- [packages/schemas/profile.schema.json](packages/schemas/profile.schema.json): profile JSON Schema
